title: GTA6 Devs Tribunal: Final Hearing Begins in Rockstar Dispute
description: The final employment tribunal hearing between Rockstar Games and 31 fired GTA 6 developers has begun in Scotland with rallies and speeches.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Devs Tribunal: Final Hearing Begins in Rockstar Dispute

The ongoing employment dispute surrounding one of the most anticipated video games in history has reached a critical stage. According to recent reports from Eurogamer, the final hearing in the employment tribunal between Rockstar Games and the 31 fired GTA 6 developers has officially commenced in Scotland.

### Rallies and Speeches Outside the Tribunal

The momentous final hearing opened not just inside the courtroom, but outside with rallies and rousing speeches. The individuals who were unceremoniously marched out of the company's offices last October gathered to make their voices heard. Carrying the poignant banner of "Today, we are fighting fear," the former developers expressed their resolve in seeking justice and fair treatment following their abrupt dismissal.

### Context and Industry Implications

Development on GTA 6 has constantly been under the global microscope, but the human cost behind major AAA video game production rarely comes into the spotlight quite like this. The sudden departure of 31 developers from company offices last October sent shockwaves through the gaming community. Now, as the employment tribunal reaches its final hearing phase in Scotland, the wider gaming industry is watching closely to see how labor rights and corporate accountability are balanced in the modern games sector.

### Editor's Take

While the hype for GTA 6 continues to shatter records, the human stories behind its development deserve equal attention. The courageous rallies in Scotland remind us that behind every masterpiece are developers who deserve fair labor practices and respect. We will continue to follow this tribunal closely as it unfolds.
